Title: Azure SQL Database—Auto-failover groups feature now available in all regions

Body.Content:
The Auto-failover groups feature of Azure SQL Database is now available for managed instance deployments in all regions. Create geo-replicated managed instances with these capabilities:

  • Geo-replication of all databases from the primary instance to a secondary instance 
  • Transparent manual or automatic failover
  • Independent routing to secondary databases for load balancing of read-only workloads
  • Geo-replication between primary and secondary instances in different virtual networks and subscriptions

Learn more about auto-failover groups >
